Title: Why Stacking Coffee and Energy Drinks Makes Your Eyelid Twitch

Description:
On your third energy drink of the day and your eyelid still won't quit? It's probably not random - stacking caffeine like that overexcites the nerve that runs your eyelid.

Coffee, energy drinks, and alcohol are three of the most common triggers, and each one also drains the magnesium your nerves need to calm back down.

Watch to find out why, and simple swaps that help.
